Forecast

Create financial forecasts to project future income and expenses.

Forecasts help with budgeting and planning future business activities.

Date

Enter the starting date for this forecast. This is when the first forecasted transaction will occur.

Repeat

Select how often this forecast should repeat. Choose 'Never' for one-time forecasts.

Growth

Enter the growth percentage for each period. For example, enter 5 for 5% growth per period.

Description

Enter a description for this forecast. This will appear on forecast reports.

Lines

Add line items for accounts and amounts to include in this forecast.

Inactive

Check this box to temporarily disable this forecast without deleting it.
